name: North Shore Glass School Kids Summer Workshops
description_short: Week long morning glass art workshops in Salem for beginners and experienced students. Kids 10 to 17 work at the main studio on Proctor Street and juniors 7 to 10 at the Artist Row studio, making pendants, bowls, cups, small sculptures and stained glass.
refund_policy_summary: Non refundable after June 1; the school can sometimes move a child to another week.

sessions.name: Kids Workshops, ages 10 to 17 (weekly, 16 Proctor St.)
Junior Workshops, ages 7 to 10 (weekly, 24 New Derby St.)

notes: Monday to Friday 9:00 to 12:00 (drop off 8:30 to 9:00, pick up 12:00 to 12:30). Kids Workshops cap at 12 a week at 16 Proctor Street; Junior Workshops cap at 8 a week at 24 New Derby Street (NSGS at Artist Row). Students may bring a light lunch. Sibling discounts and multi week bundles on request. The page gives the season as June 15 to August 24, 2026.
